$comment: Ledger for apps/studio/src/vendor. Rule 3 of docs/architecture/vendor.md: every vendored file carries a provenance header and an entry here, so its licence is auditable and a re-copy diff stays possible. `src/vendor/ledger.test.ts` fails the suite if a file in that tree is missing from both lists, or if a header stops agreeing with its entry. Upstream registry items have no commit, so `integrity` is the sha256 of the artefact fetched from `source` — the handle a refresh diffs against.
